cards.headline:
Rocketship profiles a song's
audience before release
cards.body: Rocketship's AI platform analyses 80+ audio, lyric and contextual parameters to profile a song's audience pre-release.

blocks.x: Rocketship is a new AI-powered platform that claims to be able to “identify a song’s potential audience before it’s ever released.” It says that it uses AI to “analyse more than 80 audio, lyric and contextual parameters of an artist’s song” and then delivers “a comprehensive profile of the song’s potential audience.”

According to Rocketship, the AI cross-references those parameters against millions of data points from more than 250K of the most significant songs of the last five decades. The profile covers total potential fans, genre breakdown, similar artists, demographics, geographic hotspots and the social platforms they use, and an AI command center called Mission Control builds a marketing campaign tailored to the release date and budget.

It’s not the first company to claim it can identify how a song will land before it’s released – but it’s one of the first in the AI era. One interesting quirk of the glut of AI-generated music is that we’re starting to understand better how much of a song’s hit potential is about the (human?) artist behind it and how much is about the physical properties of the song itself.
